messages:
viv: starting change window for em-sim-service  rolling em-sim-v2-quant to 15% now. primary checks: p95, 5xx, node memory pressure. deploy-bot: rollout started: em-sim-service -> em-sim-v2-quant (15%). rollout id r-2026-06-01-01 :rocket:
omar: watching SLO dashboard (/dash/slo/em-sim). will escalate if p95 > 140ms or 5xx > 0.4%. metrics-bot: perf smoke scheduled in 20s.
chen: FYI I changed model shard placement to favor GPU nodes in cohort B; that might increase pod memory footprint on those nodes. noted in release notes.
oncall: seeing a small but steady climb in node memory usage in cohort B (~+12% over 10m). not yet hitting eviction pressure but approaching 78% node alloc.
omar: can you paste node query?
oncall: ```query
sum(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) by (node)
```
oncall: top affected nodes: gpu-node-b-4 (avail 1.2GB), gpu-node-b-7 (avail 1.1GB)
viv: canary p95 in cohort B = 155ms (baseline 115ms). ops threshold breached. :rotating_light:
metrics-bot: 5xx rate in canary slice increased from 0.02% to 0.5% in last 12m. alert id slo-3001. paging eng-oncall in 2m.
viv: acknowledge. hold ramp at 15%. do not move to 40%.
chen: logs indicate occasional OOMKilled for sidecar preprocessor on em-sim-canary-57bf. stacktrace shows memory spike during batch compilation. link: https://logs.internal/zzz555
omar: heatmap shows pod memory spiking aligned with longer prompt lengths. maybe quantized weights plus sidecar peak > container request.
viv: option A: reduce sidecar cache or GC frequency and restart canary pods. Option B: pin back to v1 and abort ramp. prefer quick mitigation first.
chen: applying hotpatch to reduce SIDE_CACHE_MB from 256 -> 128 for canary and restart:
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/em-sim-canary SIDE_CACHE_MB=128 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/em-sim-canary -n prod
```
deploy-bot: rollout restart detected for em-sim-canary.
metrics-bot: after restart: canary p95 trending to 120ms, 5xx down to 0.08%. node available memory increased ~+500MB on affected nodes.
ovcall: nice recovery. proposal: keep canary at 15% for 30m with adjusted sidecar. if stable, continue ramp to 50%. if OOM or 5xx > 0.4% returns, pin to em-sim-v1 using deployctl.
viv: also create follow-up INF-1142 to add pre-ramp node memory check: fail ramp if avg available < 1.5GB in targeted cohort. chen please file.
chen: filed INF-1142 and added release note entry describing sidecar memory interaction with quantized model. link: https://docs.internal/releases/em-sim/2026-06-01
oncall: reminder: pin command if needed: `deployctl pin --service em-sim-service --version em-sim-v1 --reason "canary memory/5xx regression"` (immediate traffic shift).
ovcall: thanks team. keeping thread open for 30m. reconvene then for final decision. :thumbsup:
